headline: Muted Q2; Pricing benefits yet to flow through

highlights: While the pricing actions implemented in Q2FY27 are expected to provide a gradual offset, we have adopted a relatively cautious outlook on margin recovery, particularly for FY27E.

Cummins India (KKC) reported a modest quarterly performance, with revenue growing ~4% YoY to INR32.5bn, supported by moderate growth in domestic sales (+5% YoY to ~INR27bn) and exports (+2% YoY to INR5.7bn).
EBITDA margin contracted sharply by 658bps YoY to 18%, primarily due to elevated commodity and freight costs, supply-chain disruptions and an adverse product mix.
Despite near- term margin pressures, demand remain healthy across key domestic markets, including data centres, manufacturing and real estate, alongside continued growth in the distribution business.
